brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu moved to undermine Palestinian voting on election day, according to Middle East Eye's review of Israeli press coverage. The outlet did not specify the date of the election or the methods Netanyahu employed to obstruct Palestinian participation.

Separately, the Trump administration has called for a unity government in Israel, while hundreds of Israeli artists have issued a public appeal for a government that includes unspecified positions or groups, the review indicated.

title: Netanyahu worked to suppress Palestinian voting on election day
